The single test_iter14 failure plus the legacy test_retrain_with_insufficient_data_skips failure both point to clear backend bugs introduced this iter; the third full-suite failure (TestApplyPaymentIdempotency) passes in isolation, looks order-flaky and unrelated. critical.issue: routes/bot_routes.py update_config() ignores payload.weekly_drawdown_pct and payload.weekly_drawdown_enabled — they are NOT written to mongo, and _serialize() never includes them. PUT returns 200 but values silently dropped; GET response missing both keys. Confirmed via direct curl: PUT {weekly_drawdown_pct:9.5,weekly_drawdown_enabled:true} then GET returns weekly_pct=None, weekly_enabled=None. This breaks the spec line 'POST /api/bot/config accepts weekly_drawdown_pct + weekly_drawdown_enabled, GET /api/bot/config returns them'. Fix: add the two fields to the update dict (line ~110) and to _serialize() (line ~70).

Return-shape regression — old contract was {trained:true, n_samples, n_wins, train_auc, threshold, trained_at} at the top level. New shape nests these under 'global'. Pre-existing test backend_test.py::TestLearnedMeta::test_retrain_with_insufficient_data_skips asserts res['n_samples'] >= MIN_SAMPLES at top level and now fails with KeyError. Either restore top-level n_samples/n_wins/train_auc/threshold (mirror from 'global') or update the legacy test and any other consumers (e.g. /api/analytics/learned-meta endpoint shape).

minor.issue: Endpoint takes ~14s per call (Claude + DXY + COT + macro fetches). Not a bug, just heads-up for any synchronous UI button hitting it.

ui_bugs.issue: Toggle renders with data-testid='toggle-weekly_drawdown_enabled' but starts OFF on every reload because the backend never persists the field (root cause: backend bug above). Toggling it on reveals the WEEKLY LOSS LIMIT input correctly per code, but the value is lost on save → reload. Will resolve once the bot_routes.py fix lands; no frontend change needed.

rca of the issue: BUG 1 (weekly DD persistence): /app/backend/routes/bot_routes.py update_config() builds the mongo $set dict manually field-by-field (lines 96-123) — when iter-14 added the two new fields to BotConfigUpdate model, the route was NOT updated. Same omission in _serialize() (lines 53-83). PUT returns 200 because pydantic accepts the payload, but the route never reads .weekly_drawdown_pct or .weekly_drawdown_enabled off the validated payload. Reproduce: curl PUT with {weekly_drawdown_pct:9.5}, then curl GET — keys absent. Fix: insert lines `'weekly_drawdown_pct': payload.weekly_drawdown_pct, 'weekly_drawdown_enabled': payload.weekly_drawdown_enabled,` into the update dict around line 111, and matching lines into _serialize() around line 72. BUG 2 (retrain shape): learned_meta.retrain() return changed from flat to nested under 'global' without preserving back-compat. Reproduce: `python -c 'import asyncio; from learned_meta import retrain; print(asyncio.run(retrain()).get("n_samples"))'` returns None instead of an int. Two-line fix: in retrain() before `return {...}`, also splat the global dict into the top level: `**{k: global_doc[k] for k in ("n_samples","n_wins","train_auc","threshold","trained_at")}`.
